title: RCP confused-deputy guardrail
note: IAM-1302: an EXPLICIT SCP/RCP selection routes this Principal-bearing, deny-only org RESOURCE guardrail to the family-aware RCP evaluator (engine/rcp.js). It is a resource-control CEILING, never a grant: the confused-deputy conditions (StringNotEqualsIfExists aws:SourceOrgID + Null aws:SourceAccount + Bool aws:PrincipalIsAWSService) act TOGETHER as one guardrail (logical AND), NOT three independent denies. NO S3 permissions or public-access finding is emitted (Principal '*' is the subject the deny reaches, not a grant to anyone); zero positive capability edges; every finding states RCPs are deny-only and a corresponding Allow must exist elsewhere (intersection with identity/resource policies not supplied). Compare with the auto-detect fail-closed baseline in fixtures/acceptance-2-deferred/test-52 (detected=resource, UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_FAMILY) - the auto-detect flip is IAM-1303's job.
